steps.text: Asks for the Wine 11 engine r18 or newer. The game signs in with a Microsoft account through Xbox's sign-in, and on the default engine Wine forgets that sign-in at every start (its credential lookup fails on macOS when the Keychain has no match). The Wine 11 engines carry the fix, the same one that keeps Forza Horizon 6 signed in (highball-db#707). Everything installed in the environment stays.
